_doc: Which canonical jobs (game/data/canonical/jobs.json) are playable in this build and what advancing grants (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md section 9). A job missing here is not playable with default_reason. Optional level overrides the canonical advancement level for survivor mode; an option above the player's level shows level_reason instead. grants.items ([item ids], optional, spec #151 owner change) are Equip items handed over at the advancement: they join the Equip tab after the displaced weapon, and any that find no free slot lie at the player's feet as normal pickups, so advancing never fails. grants.max_mp adds to computed base Max MP (Improved MaxMP Increase preserves the current MP ratio on growth). grants.max_hp (added to base Max HP, like level growth) is supported alongside max_mp. format1_weapon (tier C, frozen spec #32 rule) is the weapon CharacterSnapshot.migrate gives a format-1 character of that job line, the nearest ancestor's entry; new jobs need none. paths (first jobs, spec #151 #157, #186): [{id, label, item_id, family, extra_items?}], with optional extra_items ([item ids]) appended after grants.items to the Equip tab, using the same overflow pickup rule; one job-window entry each; taking one records it on the character (snapshot weapon_path) and grants and wears its item_id without requirement checks (tier B Beginner weapons given by the instructors; Warrior has none: its sword is balance.player.weapon_grants like the Magician's Wooden Wand). weapon_families + grant_items (second jobs, spec #165 #180): the families the branch can use and, in the same order, one advancement weapon item id per family (tier C). On advancing, the weapon of the held weapon's family is worn, else the first family's; the displaced weapon and the other advancement weapons join the Equip tab and spill at the feet when it is full (like grants.items). JobTree.branch_grant() reads the pairs; a row without grant_items grants nothing (the class specs choose the ids). No job grants skills. Accepting a job opens an extra advancement skill draw before the level's normal draw; canonical skill prerequisites are ignored (tier C owner choice #31).

Growth and AP: balance.json growth/ap_stat "100".
